body:
Found by the pre-release refuter loop gating v4.1.31. PRE-EXISTING (shipped in
v4.1.30) - does not gate v4.1.31, but it is live today.

cps/services/cover_picker.py:147-150 builds functools.partial(p.search, query,
static_cover, locale) RAW and hands it to parallel.fan_out (:156), which runs it
on a real OS thread. It is the only fan-out in the codebase that omits
copy_current_request_context - compare cps/search_metadata.py:451-452, which
wraps the identical call.

Two measured consequences (harness run inside cwn-local, Flask 3.1.3,
flask-babel 4.0.0, gevent 24.11.1). Both are SILENT: neither symbol raises off
context, so the defect produces wrong output rather than a traceback.

1. cps/metadata_provider/hardcover.py:164 does
   getattr(current_user, "hardcover_token", None). Off-context
   cw_login/utils.py:395 _get_user() returns None (its has_request_context()
   guard), the LocalProxy wraps None, and the 3-arg getattr swallows the miss -
   so the token reads None. This is a COMMON path: Hardcover.active is True by
   default regardless of token, so search() always reaches :164. A user who
   configured only a per-user Hardcover token gets zero Hardcover covers in the
   cover picker and is shown "Set a Hardcover API key in Admin -> Configuration",
   while the same token works fine on Search metadata. That asymmetry between two
   surfaces backed by the same provider list is the tell.

2. cps/metadata_provider/dnb.py:463 calls
   isoLanguages.get_language_name(get_locale(), lang_code) - the only provider
   that re-reads get_locale() inside the worker instead of using the passed-in
   locale. Measured: returns None -> get_language_names(None) returns None ->
   "Unknown" -> dnb.py:464 drops EVERY language and :468 logs "Unknown language
   code from DNB" per code. Verified the same call returns Locale('de') through
   the wrapper.

Checked and clear: google.py:159, ibdb.py:111, kobo.py:436, litres.py:333,
lubimyczytac.py:266, openlibrary.py:139 all use the passed-in locale argument
(materialized on the greenlet at cover_picker.py:178), so they are unaffected.

Fix is one wrapper call matching search_metadata.py:451. Note the related
design-level gap: copy_current_request_context does NOT carry flask.g (measured
"<<MISSING>>" in the worker), so get_locale() re-invokes cps/cw_babel.py:35 on
the worker OS thread, which reads current_user.locale and triggers a ub.session
DB read off-greenlet, once per offloaded job.
title: Cover picker fan-out omits copy_current_request_context, silently dropping per-user Hardcover tokens and all DNB language data
